name: Unauthorized Modbus write
description: Modbus write command targets a PLC register or coil.

name: Large engineering workstation transfer
description: Large transfer from engineering workstation may indicate staging or exfiltration.

name: Blocked industrial command
description: Security control blocked an industrial protocol command.

name: Modbus device identification sweep
description: Device identification request can indicate OT asset discovery.

name: Large payload against HMI
description: Large transfer to HMI can indicate flooding or resource exhaustion.

name: S7 firmware maintenance command
description: Firmware or maintenance command observed against PLC.

name: BACnet command or discovery traffic
description: BACnet/IP traffic should be reviewed when observed outside known building automation segments.

name: IEC-104 control function
description: IEC-104 ASDU/control traffic can indicate grid control activity.

name: IEC 61850 MMS operation
description: IEC 61850/MMS traffic observed in control network.

name: OPC UA unusual high-volume request
description: Large OPC UA transaction may indicate discovery or data collection.

name: CODESYS engineering service observed
description: CODESYS engineering traffic can indicate PLC manipulation attempts.
